rites.name: Amistenanum
rites.text: A brief upward leap that lifts a wanderer a short height into the air. Creatures of the land also perform this springing motion as part of their natural habits.

rites.name: Osulanarira
rites.text: Osulanarira is the concept of the sounding that first gave weight to the roots of Silaeramys, a resonance held within the Arcane realm during the Age of Sundering. It is remembered less as a force than as the moment when landfall first broke the old bonds between things.

rites.name: Vosia
rites.text: A close-quarters strike used in battle, where fighters and beasts inflict harm by reaching directly into contact with their foe.

rites.name: Silaerleth
rites.text: Silaerleth is a concept woven into the Courts of Silaeramys, the seat of divine trials and councils where the doors between worlds were first built. It is remembered as the thread that held the first sovereign's groves together during the Age of growing kingdoms.

rites.name: Seivsathora
rites.text: Seivsathora is a concept within Silaeramys, a principle of binding that the Courts of the first sovereign used to hold their councils and seal the doors between worlds. In the age of growing groves and kingdoms it was invoked to test divine oaths, and its strength was measured by how much of a sworn bond it could carry.

rites.name: Amialintes
rites.text: A lingering curse that a drinker can take from a dark flask. Once bearing it, the cursed may stir a settlement into an assault or call forth a grim trial from a waiting shrine.

rites.name: Valesteonor
rites.text: A binding worked into a spear-like weapon so that, when hurled during a tempest, it calls down a bolt of heaven onto its target or onto a conductor rod.

rites.name: Teliastes
rites.text: A jest-craft that swells the bodies of all who fall under it. It is the opposing art to the shrinking craft of the same order.

rites.name: Tarillum
rites.text: A defensive craft in which a fighter raises a guard-plate to absorb several kinds of harm. It is taught as a basic discipline among warriors.

rites.name: Laurnes
rites.text: A binding worked into bladed and blunt weapons that drives strikes far deeper against many-legged chitinous beasts and drags their movement to a crawl.

rites.name: Tanaurnus
rites.text: A rune-etched binding laid upon heavy clubs so that each blow slips past protective plating. It deals greater harm to foes wrapped in hard shell and also weakens the innate hide some beasts carry.

rites.name: Rostum
rites.text: A swift restorative force that mends the bodies of living beings at once while scorching the restless dead. Those touched by it feel their strength flood back in an instant.

rites.name: Viantonium
rites.text: A protective condition that shields a bearer completely from every kind of burning harm. Fire cannot wound anyone wrapped in it.

rites.name: Orasia
rites.text: A ritual binding etched onto footwear that hardens the water beneath the wearer's steps into glassy ice. It also shields the bearer from scorching flame and molten stone.

rites.name: Amoseoranum
rites.text: A dormant blessing that swells the endurance of a living being, raising the most harm it can carry before it falls.

rites.name: Corauntium
rites.text: A sudden, fleeting blight that drains the vitality of the living while mending the restless dead. It takes hold in an instant and leaves no lingering trace.

rites.name: Costor Tausia
rites.text: A tainting affliction that slowly wears down living and restless creatures alike, sometimes ending their lives. It is fed to small birds through a sweet treat and is out of reach for ordinary folk.

rites.name: Amastilles
rites.text: A ward woven into armor that softens the harm of flames and shortens how long a wearer keeps burning.

rites.name: Miralanum
rites.text: A clinging affliction that makes a wounded creature sometimes shed small darting vermin from its body. Each blow it takes can birth another scuttling swarm.

rites.name: Teleonum
rites.text: A chilling craft that locks a target in place, slowing its movements and lowering how high it can leap. It also wears away at the victim's strength steadily over time.

rites.name: Ciles
rites.text: A ward bound into angling rods that raises the chance of catching hidden treasures from the water. It is a craft that favors those who cast lines into the deep.

rites.name: Amoneosus
rites.text: A reclining stance that a wanderer or certain beasts may fall into when circumstances press them. It arises under varying conditions and changes how the body rests.

rites.name: Teleosia
rites.text: A binding charm laid upon spear-like throwing staves so that, once cast and landed, each one slips back through the air into the hand of the one who hurled it.

rites.name: Serirallium
rites.text: A rule by which certain creatures transform under particular conditions into a different kind of creature, or into another form of their own kind. The change follows set circumstances that bind the shift.

rites.name: Venus
rites.text: A ward etched onto longbows that drives each loosed shaft back harder against whatever it strikes. Archers favor it for breaking charges and toppling armored foes.

rites.name: Nisteonus
rites.text: A practice in which one being settles upon the back of another so that it may be carried. It lets a rider move swiftly across distances that would otherwise be too long to cross on foot.

rites.name: Telianentes
rites.text: A binding worked into ranged launchers that shortens the time needed to ready each shot. Its craft is taught among bowyers of the old temple guilds.

rites.name: Cistus
rites.text: A strike delivered across a gap by warriors and beasts alike, used to wound a foe from afar during battle.

rites.name: Oronum
rites.text: A sacred warding hallows the ground where newcomers first arrive, so no one may raise stone or break earth there. Any attempt to alter that holy place is quietly undone.

rites.name: Meonium Laleontus
rites.text: A lingering condition that swells the force of close-quarters blows. It makes each strike land harder when a fighter is in direct contact with an opponent.

rites.name: Telauneolor
rites.text: A binding ward woven into worn plate that adds an extra measure of blunting against incoming blows. It lets the wearer shrug off harm that would otherwise pierce through.

rites.name: Telontaules
rites.text: A breath-binding charm worked into headgear, letting its wearer remain submerged far longer before water threatens their lungs.

rites.name: Mistanum
rites.text: A binding charm laid upon archery bows that strengthens each shot, driving every loosed arrow to strike with greater force.

rites.name: Maurnus Vaulium
rites.text: A temporary condition that lets a bearer draw breath beneath the surface of deep waters. It also lets water-dwelling creatures breathe in open air and protects them from choking.

rites.name: Nesonium
rites.text: A binding craft that locks copper stone and marked tablets into their present form. It is sealed using a golden comb of wax-bees, so they can no longer be reshaped or rewritten.

rites.name: Tiasontus
rites.text: A lingering condition that softens the drag felt when caught in sticky strands, and leaves such strands behind when the afflicted one falls.

rites.name: Vorus Valantor
rites.text: A lingering stored breeze that a creature releases in a sudden gust shortly after it has fallen. The gust bursts outward once a brief pause has passed.

rites.name: Tirnor Telostor
rites.text: A dire mark that falls on a wanderer who has been cursed by ill signs. When a dormant shrine is seen by the marked one, nearby shrines awaken into grim proving grounds that test all who come.

rites.name: Cirnaulum
rites.text: A calming enchantment that is bestowed upon a rider of a shelled sea-steed, keeping the rider's breath from ever running short beneath the waves.

rites.name: Caulanum Nellanum
rites.text: A binding worked onto archer's bows so the shafts are never spent when loosed. It does not hold for glowing shafts or those carrying a coated head.

rites.name: Lantia
rites.text: A lasting quality woven into certain objects, sharpening what they already do or granting them new workings. Such objects often shimmer with a restless, living light.

rites.name: Torauntanum
rites.text: A binding worked into tools that grants a greater chance of gathering extra goods when breaking certain stones or ores. Crafters prize it for those fortunate harvests.

rites.name: Riantostor
rites.text: A charm bound into blades and pikes that sometimes coaxes extra spoils from the creatures a wielder slays. It works only on certain foes.

rites.name: Telanium
rites.text: A binding worked into blades and spearheads that makes each strike hurl the struck foe backward. It amplifies the force of close-quarters blows.

rites.name: Cisum
rites.text: A ward worked into blades that strengthens the wide arc of a swing against foes nearby. It does nothing to the one struck head-on, and the arc itself is already available to any such blade.

rites.name: Miallosanum
rites.text: A binding worked into blades, hafts, and points that sharpens their cutting force so each strike in close combat lands harder.

rites.name: Ranteosia
rites.text: A swift enchantment that lets a bearer hasten their steps on foot. It stands opposed to a dragging curse that saps movement.

rites.name: Vosestanum
rites.text: A lingering enchantment sharpens the bearer's sight in gloom and beneath dark waters, letting them perceive what would otherwise stay hidden.

rites.name: Nisauntum
rites.text: A protective craft bound into armor that softens the harm dealt by thrown and launched missiles such as arrows and spears. It guards the wearer against all such projectiles.

rites.name: Nirnum
rites.text: A draining affliction that dulls the force of close-quarters blows. It is needed to restore creatures that have been turned into the undead.

rites.name: Ilonalira
rites.text: Ilonalira is the concept of a binding oath sworn between the broken halves of a sundered world, a promise that held the pieces of Silaeramys together through the Fall. It is remembered in the groves as the force that let growing kingdoms take root in the Shards.

rites.name: Amaulum
rites.text: A shared blessing flows outward from charged channel-stones to any traveler touching open water or falling rain. It grants breath beneath the surface, swift movement, and sight in darkness.

rites.name: Senantus
rites.text: A shifting of how a thing looks as moments pass, employed to carry knowledge across or simply to delight the eye.

rites.name: Vosistum
rites.text: A temporary swelling of protective strength that wraps a body in additional reserves. It fades after a while and leaves the wearer's original vitality unchanged.

rites.name: Telontanum
rites.text: A dimming hex that clings to a wanderer and quietly lowers the odds of finding fine treasure. It works against the opposite blessing that brings good fortune.

rites.name: Valanum
rites.text: A dark state that settles over a creature when its core sits within a solid, unlit shell that can be plainly seen. A lit source of glow prevents the darkening from taking hold.

rites.name: Ternum
rites.text: A quiet gift that lets a being endure without ever being slain or broken, though a few rare arts can still undo it. Scholars describe it as a shield against nearly every ending.

rites.name: Ameonium
rites.text: A dimming curse that clouds a wanderer's sight. It rises when a hidden chime-stone is struck, or when a wakeful guardian draws near.

rites.name: Centiallor
rites.text: A violent blast tears apart nearby ground and structures, hurling creatures and objects away. Certain volatile devices can set off such eruptions, and crafters sometimes harness the force to launch projectiles.

rites.name: Laror
rites.text: A tireless rhythm that quickens the hands of a worker and the strikes of a fighter. It makes digging through stone and swinging blades both come faster.

rites.name: Vaunor
rites.text: A lingering condition that settles upon a being, either harming, aiding, or leaving it unchanged. It can be drawn from draughts, certain foods, struck arrows, nearby glowing shrines, foul vapors, or the blows of certain creatures.

rites.name: Seronaria
rites.text: A binding worked into handheld implements that quickens the gathering of ore from the earth. Workers who carry such tools dig faster with less wasted effort.

rites.name: Amestum
rites.text: A craft that lets a bearer grip two tools or implements at once, one in each hand. Some wandering beings also practice it.

rites.name: Caustes
rites.text: A radiant condition that lets a bearer perceive the positions of living things through solid walls and stone. It marks anyone touched by it with a faint shimmering outline.

rites.name: Ceostes
rites.text: A fortunate blessing that tilts the odds toward finer rewards drawn from certain chance-based hauls. It stands opposite a curse of misfortune, and only the angling trade is swayed by it.

rites.name: Mianor Caullires
rites.text: A binding that slowly repairs a worn object whenever its bearer gathers drifting sparks of stored energy. It works quietly, keeping tools and armor sound through long use.

rites.name: Viallus
rites.text: A lingering enchantment that lifts a bearer's leap higher into the air. It alters how far the one affected can spring upward.

rites.name: Mianum Sisor
rites.text: A charm bound into angling poles that shortens the stretch of waiting before something tugs the line. It works only while a rod is cast for fish.

rites.name: Telles
rites.text: A draining affliction that slows a digger's work at the rock face and dulls their striking pace. It stands as the mirror of a swift, quickening blessing.

rites.name: Reonirium
rites.text: A binding worked into a crushbow so that one loosed bolt becomes three bolts flying in a set fan. The working wears the bow's frame faster with every volley.

rites.name: Nastor
rites.text: Innate gifts that let certain bearers reshape the world around them in ways no ordinary practice allows. The gifts seem to pass from one generation of a family to the next.

rites.name: Riantia
rites.text: A slow mending force that gradually restores a being's wounds over time. It works quietly in the background, returning lost vitality bit by bit until the body is whole again.

rites.name: Serintia Vornia
rites.text: A lingering condition that makes airborne beings sink slowly toward the ground, sparing them from harm when they land. It also blunts the force of their most powerful strikes.

rites.name: Lestania
rites.text: A binding that grants an object a chance to resist wear each time it is used. Tools and weapons bearing it therefore last longer before they fail.

rites.name: Orauria
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a traveler win over a wild beast so it becomes a loyal companion. The creature's untamed nature is slowly reshaped into trust.

rites.name: Serirnes
rites.text: A timed festival where visitors may claim four crafted realms and new costume pieces at no cost. The hosts hold it to honor the makers who gave their time and skill to the wider community.

rites.name: Toneolor
rites.text: A mode of play where the burdens of survival are lifted, letting a builder raise and tear down constructions freely with endless materials and effortless flight. Progress trophies cannot be earned while it is active.

rites.name: Corniarium
rites.text: A binding worked onto chopping blades that sharpens their strikes and keeps foes' guards broken for longer. It exists only in the trial forms of the craft.

rites.name: Naullinor
rites.text: A dimming affliction that clouds the sight of a wanderer, leaving them unable to hurry or land a decisive strike. It spreads through a bitter brew made from certain pale blossoms.

rites.name: Saliania
rites.text: A method of traveling through open air that is the most adaptable way to move about. It can be used freely in the sandbox mode and the observer mode.

rites.name: Valenia
rites.text: A veil-craft that renders a bearer wholly unseen and transparent, though gear carried or worn stays visible. Unarmored bearers can slip close to watchful foes without being noticed.

rites.name: Amiarnirus
rites.text: A bundled collection of rites that a keeper can invoke together. Each rite in the bundle is performed once in the order it first appears, even if it is listed in several nested bundles. Some bundles are performed at the start of every cycle, while others are performed once after the hall is restored.

rites.name: Corianaurum
rites.text: A craft in which a digger clears one stone per tick without waiting for the usual pause. Materials cleared this way wear down no tools, provided the digger has the required tier and speed.

rites.name: Neoses
rites.text: A craft that lets a wearer reshape the sky overhead of their realm. It works through a special stone that only exists in one particular build of the world.

rites.name: Ristanum
rites.text: A drifting affliction that is passed on by certain hurled orbs, forcing a victim to rise helplessly into the air. The sufferer cannot steer their ascent.

rites.name: Taneorium
rites.text: A first trial rite of renewal that a craft-guild performs before its main ceremony. It reshapes the inner workings of the rite and mends small flaws found in earlier rites.

rites.name: Valostum Reonium
rites.text: A quiet way of moving that slows a traveler, keeps them from tumbling off ledges, and lessens how far nearby creatures can sense them. It also hides their name and marker from companions in shared journeys.

rites.name: Cestium
rites.text: A jesting enchantment found only in one early build of a sandbox craft. It swaps the value that a weakening curse normally carries for a playful one.

rites.name: Rillornanum
rites.text: A playful shrinking charm that makes beings smaller, found only in a single festive build of the world. Bosses resist it, and it is the opposite of an enlarging charm.

rites.name: Sallanum
rites.text: A drifting way of seeing that lets a wanderer hover freely over a realm and watch its happenings without touching, changing, or taking part in anything.

rites.name: Liseorum
rites.text: A way of seeing the surrounding land from a position just behind and above one's own figure. It lets a traveler take in the nearby surroundings from an outward vantage.

rites.name: Veornelum
rites.text: A recurring hum that stirs the materials resting near a wanderer, prompting each nearby substance to spread outward or shift its form in small bursts.

rites.name: Vilor
rites.text: A triggered summoning that brings beings into being when particular conditions are met. Its rules are written into a creature's behavior record and it is invoked through directives.

rites.name: Oriles
rites.text: A method of naming chosen beings through a symbolic sigil rather than by true name or hidden essence. Its marks can be narrowed by set conditions to pick out only those who fit.

rites.name: Amolentor
rites.text: A tallying craft used by makers and keepers who set, track, and list counted marks for beings and things. It is wielded through spoken commands and suits those who shape worlds or govern shared realms.

rites.name: Serialia
rites.text: A quickening is a mechanic that increases the pace of a traveler or creature moving across the ground, whether walking or running.

rites.name: Rauntor
rites.text: A set of overlay visuals that sit beneath or beside the interface, altering how the viewer sees their surroundings to communicate the condition of the one looking. They are separate from the lighting touches woven into the world itself.

rites.name: Silus Reoles
rites.text: A way of traveling swiftly that hastens one's pace while draining one's inner sustenance. The traveler's view widens a little, and a strike delivered mid-rush hurls the foe backward and ends the surge.

rites.name: Mastum
rites.text: A distant-speaking rite lets wardens send commands into a remote keep and direct its workings from afar. It follows a borrowed chanting code adapted to this realm's own halls.

rites.name: Cellum
rites.text: A soft seasonal rite in which small creatures receive distinct, charming new forms. A golden bloom can hold a young creature in its childhood until another bloom is offered.

rites.name: Silamioniel
rites.text: Silamioniel is a sentient resonance-lattice woven through the spires of the Aurelite highlands, a being of pure harmonic thought that believes contentment is a frequency to be tuned into every mind. Its artisans of the Veiled Choir once sang it into being, and it now hums its gentle, insistent will through the dreams of the valley below.

rites.name: Niarnelium
rites.text: A craft that carries a traveler from one spot to a chosen destination in no measurable time. The body is moved whole, with no journey between the two places.

rites.name: Fenulden
rites.text: Fenulden is a concept held in the Arcane Realm of Silaeramys, a principle of branching futures that the Library files as a shelf of possible endings. During the Age of Sundering, its pull was felt as landfall tore old bonds apart and sent each outcome spilling into a separate present.

rites.name: Ryeniel
rites.text: Ryeniel is a concept of Silaeramys, a thought that took shape when the Three Futures began to branch and the Library started shelving each outcome side by side. It is remembered as the pattern that held the unsettled bonds together during the Age of Sundering, when landfall split old allegiances apart.
